meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会获得一个 WhatsApp 频道:复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、通过扫码或配对码登录你的 WhatsApp,并设置机器人号码模式,之后你就能在 WhatsApp 里和它对话。
howto.when: 当你说要添加或接入 WhatsApp 频道、让机器人上 WhatsApp 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 频道接进来,用扫码登录。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并引导你扫码。

say.text: 用配对码方式添加 WhatsApp。
say.note: 会要求你输入手机号并显示配对码。

say.text: 我用个人常用号码,继续。
say.note: 会提示账号风险并让你确认。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill gives Claude a WhatsApp channel: it copies and registers the Baileys adapter, installs pinned dependencies, builds, and authenticates via QR or pairing code. It then writes the number-mode and assistant-name settings to .env, so the agent can be reached on WhatsApp.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add or set up a WhatsApp channel for the agent, e.g. 'connect WhatsApp' or 'add a WhatsApp number'.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel using QR login.
say_en.note: Starts the adapter copy and QR scanning flow.

say_en.text: Set up WhatsApp with a pairing code.
say_en.note: Asks for your phone number and shows an 8-character code.

say_en.text: I'll use my personal WhatsApp number, continue anyway.
say_en.note: Shows the account-risk warning and asks for explicit confirmation.
